image.name: deluge
image.description: [Deluge](http://deluge-torrent.org/) is a lightweight, Free Software, cross-platform BitTorrent client.  * Full Encryption * WebUI * Plugin System * Much more...

changelog.desc: Pin libtorrent to 2.0.13 due to deprecated function. Fix cron for GeoIP updates.
Install from pypi due to Alpine geoip package deprecation.
Fix some issues with GeoIP updates.
Update GeoIP provider, add weekly cronjob to update.
Prevent race condition related delay during container stop.
Add optional port 58846 to readme for thin client connectivity.
Bump unrar to 6.2.8, deprecate armhf as per [https://www.linuxserver.io/armhf](https://www.linuxserver.io/armhf).
Restore geoip using py3-geoip as an interim measure.
Remove GeoIP packages as geoip will not build under Py 3.11 and Deluge still doesn't support geoip2.
Update GeoIP URL for new IPFS domain.
Rebase to Alpine Edge again to follow latest releases.
Rebase to Alpine, config on first startup, add GeoIP.
Remove host networking from readme examples
Deprecate `UMASK_SET` in favor of UMASK in baseimage, see above for more information.
Add python3 requests and future modules.
Add ability to set LogLevel for Deluge.
Switching to new Base images, shift to arm32v7 tag.
Rebase to Ubuntu Bionic, add pipeline multiarch logic.
Add variable for user defined umask.
Switch to libressl as openssl deprecated from alpine linux and deluge dependency no longer installs
Use pip packages for some critical dependencies.

env_vars.name: DELUGE_LOGLEVEL
env_vars.desc: set the loglevel output when running Deluge, default is info for deluged and warning for delgued-web

ports.desc: Default deluged port for thin client connectivity

image.title: Deluge
image.setup_instructions:
The admin interface is available at `http://SERVER-IP:8112` with a default user/password of admin/deluge.

To change the password (recommended) log in to the web interface and go to Preferences->Interface->Password.

Change the inbound port to 6881 (or whichever port you've mapped for the container) under Preferences->Network, otherwise random ports will be used.

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  deluge:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/deluge:latest
    container_name: deluge
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
      - DELUGE_LOGLEVEL=error #optional
    volumes:
      - /path/to/deluge/config:/config
      - /path/to/downloads:/downloads
    ports:
      - 8112:8112
      - 6881:6881
      - 6881:6881/udp
      - 58846:58846 #optional
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=deluge \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -e DELUGE_LOGLEVEL=error `#optional` \
  -p 8112:8112 \
  -p 6881:6881 \
  -p 6881:6881/udp \
  -p 58846:58846 `#optional` \
  -v /path/to/deluge/config:/config \
  -v /path/to/downloads:/downloads \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/deluge:latest
